同一方阵，不同输入和输出: The same matrix shape, different inputs and outputs
换坐标、换尺度、反转磁畴: Changing coordinates, rescaling channels, and reversing magnetic domains
一个正值能证明所有方向吗: Does one positive value establish positivity in every direction?
只反转外磁场: Reverse only the external magnetic field
抽象一偶一奇通道: Abstract channels with opposite time-reversal parities
只施加平面四重旋转，不预设指标对称，横向反对称项能保留吗？: With only a planar fourfold rotation and no assumed index symmetry, can an antisymmetric transverse term remain?
能，空间约束允许反对称块: Yes: the spatial constraint permits an antisymmetric block
不能，四重旋转使全部非对角元为零: No: fourfold rotation sets every off-diagonal entry to zero
能，但两个非对角元必须相等: Yes, but the off-diagonal entries must be equal
正确。一般平面矩阵可为 [[a,b],[-b,a]]；再加静态介电的指标对称性才: Correct. The general planar matrix can be [[a,b],[-b,a]]. Adding the index symmetry of a static dielectric response then requires b=0.
四重旋转本身允许反对称块。把静态介电的额外指标对称性搬到 Hall 输运会漏掉允: Fourfold rotation alone permits an antisymmetric block. Importing the additional index symmetry of static dielectric response into Hall transport would remove an allowed term.
一般四重旋转约束给 Lxy=-Lyx。要求二者相等属于额外的指标对称条件。: The general fourfold constraint gives Lxy=-Lyx. Requiring equality is an additional index-symmetry condition.
电荷与能量状态变量均为时间偶，对应电流与能流应怎样变换？: Charge and energy state variables are time-even. How do the corresponding charge and energy currents transform?
电流变号，能流不变: Charge current changes sign; energy current does not
正确。时间反演不改变电荷和能量密度，但改变其变化率或守恒流的方向。: Correct. Time reversal preserves charge and energy densities but reverses their rates of change or associated conserved currents.
状态变量与流不是同一对象。时间反演使变化率或守恒流多一个负号。: A state variable and its flux are different objects. Its rate of change or associated conserved current acquires an extra minus sign under time reversal.
热能的输运方向也在时间反演下改变；不能因能量为偶而把能流也标成偶。: The direction of energy transport also reverses. An even energy variable does not make its current even.
在下方声明的一维零场约定中，Seebeck 与 Peltier 系数满足什么关系: Under the one-dimensional, zero-field convention stated below, how are the Seebeck and Peltier coefficients related?
正确。熵共轭系数的相等经电化学场和温度梯度的定义产生 T₀ 因子。: Correct. Equal entropy-conjugate coefficients produce a factor T₀ when expressed using the electrochemical field and temperature gradient.
相等的是这里的 L12 与 L21。实验式中电化学场和温度梯度的缩放不同，不能漏: Here L12 and L21 are equal. The electrochemical field and temperature gradient carry different scaling factors in the measured relations, so T₀ must be retained.
本例明确定义开路时 Eec=S∇T；采用其他电压或梯度方向约定时，须连同定义一起: This example explicitly defines Eec=S∇T under open-circuit conditions. Other voltage or gradient directions require comparing the definitions along with the signs.
只把第二个力乘一个尺度、保持流不变，新的方阵不对称就说明物理互易失效吗？: If only the second force is rescaled while the fluxes are unchanged, does an asymmetric new matrix establish a physical failure of reciprocity?
不能，须先检查新的力流是否熵共轭: No: first check whether the new force-flux pair is entropy-conjugate
说明失效，任何响应方阵都必须对称: Yes: every square response matrix must be symmetric
不用比较，只看对角元: Do not compare: inspect only the diagonal entries
正确。仅改力后，熵产生带有配对度量；普通矩阵转置不再是原约定的互易检验。: Correct. A force-only change introduces a pairing metric into entropy production. Ordinary transposition is no longer the reciprocity test in the original convention.
新坐标仍可描述同一物理响应。必须把熵产生的配对规则也变换，才有可比的互易条件。: The new coordinates can describe the same physical response. Transform the entropy-production pairing too before comparing reciprocity conditions.
对角元既不能检验交叉互易，也不能保证所有方向非负耗散。: Diagonal entries alone neither test cross-channel reciprocity nor ensure nonnegative dissipation in every direction.
非零 Bz、Mz 时，镜面跨磁态协变残差为零，是否证明原磁畴保持该镜面？: For nonzero Bz and Mz, does a zero mirror-covariance residual between magnetic states establish mirror symmetry of the original domain?
不能，镜面还翻转两个轴矢量参量: No: the mirror also reverses both axial-vector controls
能，镜面就是平面内旋转: Yes: a mirror is just a planar rotation
正确。应区分连接相反磁态的协变，与同一完整状态在操作后不变。: Correct. Covariance connecting opposite magnetic states differs from invariance of one complete state.
这里的面内镜面使 Bz 与 Mz 变号；非零参量不保持原值。: This in-plane mirror reverses Bz and Mz; nonzero controls do not retain their original values.
镜面行列式为 -1；轴矢量变换多出行列式因子，不能当作正旋转。: A mirror has determinant -1. Axial-vector transformations include that determinant factor and cannot be treated as proper rotations.
本例磁化非零时，只反 B 不反 M 的残差非零，可以直接否定 Onsager 吗: With nonzero magnetization in this example, can a nonzero residual from reversing B alone directly refute Onsager reciprocity?
不能，完整比较还要反转 M: No: the complete comparison also reverses M
可以，反转 B 总是足够: Yes: reversing B is always sufficient
正确。全部时间反演奇控制量必须一并反转，再交换激励与读出通道。: Correct. Reverse all time-odd controls together and exchange the driving and readout channels.
当 M 保持非零时，这不是与原磁态时间反演对应的配置；工具同时给出完整反转残差。: Keeping a nonzero M does not produce the time-reversed configuration. The tool also reports the residual for complete reversal.
互易比较包括完整响应矩阵、通道转置和变量奇偶，不能只交换两个对角元。: A reciprocity comparison includes the complete response matrix, transposed channels, and variable parities; exchanging diagonal entries is insufficient.
一个互易方阵的两个对角元都为正，是否保证全部激励方向的熵产生非负？: Do positive diagonal entries in a reciprocal matrix guarantee nonnegative entropy production for every driving direction?
不保证，还要检查对称部分的最小本征值: No: also check the smallest eigenvalue of its symmetric part
保证，正对角元就足够: Yes: positive diagonal entries are sufficient
正确。对称交叉项足够大时，仍存在熵产生为负的方向。: Correct. Sufficiently large symmetric cross terms still allow a direction with negative entropy production.
本例两个对角元为 1 和 1.4，但 X=(1,-1) 给出负二次型。: Here the diagonal entries are 1 and 1.4, yet X=(1,-1) produces a negative quadratic form.
正迹是本征值之和为正，不排除其中一个本征值为负。: A positive trace means the sum of eigenvalues is positive; one eigenvalue can still be negative.
改变实共轭力方向时，Hall 反对称部分对熵产生的净贡献是什么？: As the real conjugate force changes direction, what is the net entropy-production contribution of the antisymmetric Hall part?
恒为零，两项相消: Always zero: the two terms cancel
正确。两个交叉项等大反号；改变力方向不会让实反对称二次型产生净耗散。: Correct. The cross terms are equal and opposite. Changing the force direction cannot make a real antisymmetric quadratic form produce net dissipation.
单个交叉项可为负，但必须把与它配对的另一项相加。: One cross term may be negative, but its paired term must also be included.
Hall 反对称项改变流的方向；实共轭力的总熵产生只由对称部分决定。: The antisymmetric Hall term changes the current direction. For real conjugate forces, only the symmetric part determines total entropy production.
在 X=(1,0) 下测到正熵产生，是否已经排除了其他方向的负值？: Does positive entropy production at X=(1,0) rule out negative values in other directions?
没有，须改变方向或检验最小本征值: No: change direction or check the smallest eigenvalue
已经排除，一次正值足够: Yes: one positive value is sufficient
正确。保持同一个矩阵，改为 X=(1,-1) 就能给出反例。: Correct. Keeping the same matrix and changing to X=(1,-1) gives a counterexample.
一次激励只检验一个二次型值，不代表整个激励空间。: One applied force tests one quadratic-form value, not the entire driving space.
互易与被动性是两个不同条件。本例互易残差为零，但最小耗散本征值为负。: Reciprocity and passivity are separate conditions. This example has zero reciprocity residual but a negative smallest dissipation eigenvalue.
先指定作用空间，再读矩阵的行和列: Specify the action space before reading matrix rows and columns
此处两个指标是电荷、能量两种标量通道，不是 x、y 空间坐标。: These indices label charge and energy scalar channels, not spatial x and y coordinates.
此处两个指标是同一平面内的 x、y 空间坐标。: These indices label spatial x and y components in one plane.
行是输出，列是输入: Rows are outputs; columns are inputs
共轭驱动力 Xx、Xy: Conjugate driving forces Xx and Xy
平衡势二阶导数给指标对称: Second derivatives of an equilibrium potential give index symmetry

这里只计算静态极化响应，P·E 不是此输运模型的熵产生率。: This is a static polarization response. P·E is not the entropy-production rate of this transport model.
以下量均为本页的无量纲熵共轭参考，不是材料输运系数。: The following quantities form a dimensionless entropy-conjugate reference, not material transport coefficients.
把空间限制与内禀限制分开: Separate spatial constraints from intrinsic constraints
再要求静态介电的 χ=χᵀ，才得到平面块 χ=aI。一般 Hall 输运不能直接: Adding the static dielectric condition χ=χᵀ gives the planar block χ=aI. General Hall transport cannot directly inherit that index symmetry.
单独考察一个局部松弛参考：a 是偏离平衡的状态变量，熵在平衡附近取二次型。熵共轭: Consider a separate local relaxation reference: a denotes deviations from equilibrium, and entropy is quadratic nearby. The conjugate force is its derivative with respect to a state variable; the flux is the variable's rate of change. This gives the pairing a concrete origin without calling static polarization a transport flux.
状态、熵共轭力与流的时间反演奇偶: Time-reversal parities of states, conjugate forces, and fluxes
流多出的负号来自时间方向反转。Onsager 互易还依赖微观可逆性，不能通过把固: The extra flux minus sign comes from reversing time. Onsager reciprocity additionally relies on microscopic reversibility; simply reversing an irreversible constitutive law does not prove it.
空间分量例子固定默认 Hall 矩阵，X=(0.7,-0.4)。明确采用 v′=: The spatial example fixes the default Hall matrix and X=(0.7,-0.4). The component map is explicitly v′=Qv; active sample rotation and passive coordinate changes must be named separately.
本例固定零场、两偶标量通道的 L=[[1,0.25],[0.25,1.4]] 与: This example fixes two even scalar channels at zero field, L=[[1,0.25],[0.25,1.4]], and X=(1,-0.4). The channels are not spatial x and y components.
流和力必须按配对规则一起比较: Compare forces and fluxes using their pairing rule
正交分量映射同时作用于流与力，矩阵每个空间指标各变换一次。: An orthogonal component map acts on both flux and force, transforming each spatial matrix index once.
重新选择标量通道尺度时，流按 A 变换，熵共轭力按逆转置变换。本例只缩放两个时间: When scalar channel scales change, fluxes transform by A and conjugate forces by its inverse transpose. This example only rescales two time-even channels.
此反例仅改力 Y=CX，流 J 保持原值。Y 与原 J 已不是普通欧氏点积下的熵: This counterexample changes only the forces, Y=CX, leaving J unchanged. Y and the original J are no longer conjugate under the ordinary Euclidean dot product.
用熵产生检查比较是否仍是同一件事: Use entropy production to check that the comparison describes the same response
同一响应与两种配对计算: One response with two pairing calculations
直接相乘新显示分量: Direct product of the newly displayed components
新显示矩阵与普通转置的距离: Distance of the displayed matrix from its ordinary transpose
新的 K 可以不对称而仍描述原来同一个互易响应。先恢复正确的配对度量，再谈互易；: An asymmetric K can still describe the original reciprocal response. Restore the correct pairing metric before testing reciprocity. At unit scale, the example returns to the original convention.
该固定 Hall 平面块在正旋转下保持形式，横向反对称项仍可存在。不能把同一磁态: This fixed Hall block retains its form under proper planar rotations and can retain its antisymmetric transverse term. Ordinary asymmetry at one magnetic state is not a reciprocity violation.
配对重标度保持 σ。这里两通道均为偶；若混合不同时间奇偶通道，奇偶算符也必须随基: Paired rescaling preserves σ. Both channels here are even. Mixing channels of different time parities would also require transforming the parity operator instead of retaining its old diagonal signs.
本段单独固定默认 Hall 模型的 B=0.6、M=0.3、d=0.4。它不继承: This separate section fixes the default Hall model at B=0.6, M=0.3, d=0.4. It does not inherit the scalar-channel scale above.
所选反转的互易残差: Reciprocity residual for the selected reversal
B 与 M 全反转的残差: Residual after reversing both B and M
镜面跨磁态协变残差: Mirror covariance residual between magnetic states
镜面同一磁态不变残差: Mirror invariance residual at the same magnetic state
面内镜面的行列式为 -1，垂直平面的 Bz、Mz 是轴矢量分量，所以都变号。镜面: The in-plane mirror has determinant -1, so the perpendicular axial-vector components Bz and Mz both reverse. Connecting opposite magnetic states does not make the original nonzero magnetic state mirror-invariant.
镜面两项残差使用原镜面预设 a=1、b=1.4；与上方四重旋转预设的平均对角值分: The mirror residuals use the original mirror preset a=1, b=1.4, separately from the averaged diagonal values of the fourfold preset above. Reversing B without M gives an incomplete comparison, not a failure of the full Onsager test.
固定矩阵和幅度下，熵产生随激励方向变化: Entropy production versus driving direction at fixed matrix and amplitude

保持原有互易但非被动候选 L=[[1,2],[2,1.4]]。正、负方向按钮使用: Keep the existing reciprocal but nonpassive candidate L=[[1,2],[2,1.4]]. The direction buttons select exactly (1,0) and (1,-1) without changing the model.
保持默认 Hall 模型 L=[[1.2,0.36],[-0.36,1.2]]。: Keep the default Hall model L=[[1.2,0.36],[-0.36,1.2]]. Its antisymmetric term changes the response-current direction.
曲线使用当前力的幅度扫描全部方向；橙色点是当前选择。连续角度用浮点三角函数，端点: The curve scans every direction at the current force amplitude; the orange point marks the current choice. Continuous angles use floating-point trigonometry, so endpoints can retain machine-precision residuals.

全部奇参量反转的互易残差: Reciprocity residual after reversing all time-odd controls
某个激励方向的正值，不保证其他方向也非负。要对全部实共轭力非负，须要求 S 的最: A positive value in one direction does not ensure positivity elsewhere. Nonnegative production for every real conjugate force requires the smallest eigenvalue of S to be nonnegative.
让 Hall 两个交叉项相消: Watch the two Hall cross terms cancel
反对称二次型的四项: The four terms of the antisymmetric quadratic form
反对称部分对实共轭力的净熵产生为零。选中 Hall 模型且两个力分量均非零时，可: The antisymmetric part contributes zero net entropy production for real conjugate forces. Select the Hall model with both force components nonzero to see equal and opposite nonzero cross terms.
本段是零场、单一空间方向、在均匀 T₀ 附近的线性化约定。所有数值仍是无量纲代数: This section uses one spatial direction at zero field, linearized about uniform T₀. Every number remains a dimensionless algebraic reference; the matrix does not establish experimental units or material constants.
围绕均匀温度 T₀ 和化学势 μ₀ 保留线性阶，热流 jq=ju-μ₀jn；jn: To linear order about uniform T₀ and μ₀, heat current is jq=ju-μ₀jn. Here jn is particle current and je is charge current; they are distinct. This section chooses the reference energy zero so that μ₀=0. Energy and heat currents then have the same values in this convention, allowing reuse of the same numerical L.
将电化学驱动场定义为 Eec，并使用与热流熵共轭的温度力。一般非零 μ₀ 时须同: Define the electrochemical driving field as Eec and use the temperature force conjugate to heat current. For general nonzero μ₀, both fluxes and forces must transform; renaming energy current as heat current while retaining the original matrix is insufficient.
定义开路 je=0 时 Eec=S∇T；等温 ∇T=0 时 Π=jq/je。先分: Define Eec=S∇T at open circuit, je=0, and Π=jq/je under isothermal conditions, ∇T=0. Eliminate the appropriate variables in each case.
换用相反电压或温度梯度方向时，须连同 S 与 Π 的定义一起核对符号；不能仅对照: Reversing voltage or temperature-gradient conventions requires checking the definitions of S and Π along with their signs.
这说明为何实验式中的交叉系数不总是直接数值相等。一般有限场、张量热电和接触测量需: This explains why cross coefficients in measured relations need not be numerically equal. General finite-field, tensor, and contact measurements require the original tools and additional measurement conventions.

实反对称二次型恒为零；实对称矩阵可正交对角化，所以全部方向二次型非负等价于全部本: A real antisymmetric quadratic form vanishes. A real symmetric matrix is orthogonally diagonalizable, so a nonnegative quadratic form in every direction is equivalent to nonnegative eigenvalues. Reciprocity alone does not impose that condition.
